Latency: p50 <= 60ms for embeddings; p95 <= 120ms for short chat responses (model-dependent)
Throughput: baseline 30 req/s, burst up to 120 req/s during product releases
Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to reserve capacity for predictable unit economics but needs model to show ROI vs current vendor
Model preferences: open-model variants preferred (price/latency tradeoffs); fallback path to smaller quantized variant for burst
Routing: prefer single-region (us-east) primary, failover to us-west; VPC peering required for Dedicated
SLA: desire 99.9% inference endpoint uptime, request transparency on scheduled maintenance windows and rollback policies
